verdict.rationale: Luma's own docs claim style references carried into generated assets, video-to-video and image-to-video generation, and Modify Video adherence modes that can apply a stylistic look to source footage. However, the style-reference workflow for creating new footage from a reference clip or image is only a one-line marketing mention, and Modify Video restyles the source clip itself rather than producing new footage in a borrowed style. missing for 10: documented how-to or API parameters for style-reference-driven generation of new footage, explicit support for a video (not just image) as a pure style reference, hands-on or independent corroboration of style fidelity.

support.subject: As a creator, I can point at a reference video or image and generate new footage in that style

citations.quote: carrying style references, character references, and visual grounding into every asset.
